title: Kissed Dutch Chicken Salad
description: A vibrant, sour-sweet salad featuring poached halal chicken, dried red chilies, and crisp greens, finished with a creamy dressing.
instructions: In a saucepan, combine water, salt, and dried red chili flakes; bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken thighs and poach for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Remove the chicken and let it rest for 5 minutes, then shred into bite‑sized pieces.
In a small bowl whisk together white wine vinegar, olive oil, and lemon juice to make a bright dressing.
Toss the mixed salad greens, diced cucumber, shredded carrot, and thinly sliced red onion with the dressing.
Gently fold in the shredded chicken and crumbled feta cheese.
Sprinkle the salad with the dressing and adjust seasoning with extra salt if needed.
Serve immediately on chilled plates for a crisp, refreshing dish.
Garnish with a few parsley leaves if desired.
Enjoy the unique combination of sour, crisp, and indulgent flavors.
